body: This union took place well before hostility was fueled in the late 1980s by Bernard Tapie and Canal+. Playing side by side under a single banner, players from both clubs faced prestigious opponents in friendly fixtures unthinkable today.

body: Aquella unión efímera se produjo antes de que la enemistad deportiva fuera impulsada a finales de los años 80 por Bernard Tapie y Canal+. Unidos con una misma camiseta, marselleses y parisinos desafiaron a rivales de prestigio en choques hoy impensables.
